entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Through: Ms. Kamini Devi,
THE STATE (GOVT. OF NCT OF DELHI)
Through: Mr. Sanjeev  with SI B  Puri, Del  Mr. Adity  responden  in person
CORAM:
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE MANOJ KUMAR

OH  ORDER % 10.09.2024 CRL.M.A. 27328/2024 (exemption)
1.
Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. The application is disposed of.

1. The present proceedings are instituted on behalf of the petitioners seeking quashing of FIR No.
1840/2006 registered under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC at Police Station Sultanpuri, Delhi on the ground that the parties have amicably settled their disputes.

2. Issue notice.
3. Notice is accepted by learned APP for State as well as by learned counsel for the respondent No.2.
4. Learned APP submits that the charge-sheet has been filed against a total of 7 accused persons, out of which two accused persons namely

entities.text: Sushma and Mukesh Kumar & Ors vs The State (Govt. Of Nct Of Delhi) & Anr
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Arjun have been declared as Proclaimed Offenders and they have not been impleaded in the present petition.

5. Learned counsel for the respondent No.2, on instructions from respondent No.2 who is present in Court, states that she has no objection to the quashing of the FIR against all of the accused persons.
6. At this stage, learned counsel for the petitioner seeks to implead Sushma and Arjun in the present petition by way of filing an amended memo of parties.
Let the amended memo of parties be filed today itself.
7. Renotify on 11.09.2024.
MANOJ KUMAR OHRI, J SEPTEMBER 10, 2024/rd
